label: r8-P2-winner-lb60-rb7-rr2dd-hi0.25-lo0.2
description: Lagged dynamic martingale allocator. Rotates among 4 sleeves (ANKR-q, R6-QB, R4-combo, R5-fine) using rolling_return_minus_2x_DD score over 60d lookback, rebalanced every 7d. Uses only prior-window metrics (no lookahead).

metrics.methodology_note: Allocator recomputes sleeve scores using only data ending at rebalance timestamp (lagged), then picks highest score sleeve for next 7d window. Sleeve equity curves pre-computed via portfolio_budget_replay.

anti_overfit_properties.note: Allocator itself has zero free parameters fitted on the full period - it is a meta-strategy that adapts sleeve weights using lagged signals.

limitations.live_parity_status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in trading-engine. Allocator logic only exists in scripts/glm_r8_regime_rescue_allocator.py (backtest-side Python). To deploy live, the trading-engine would need a portfolio-level scheduler that: (1) tracks per-sleeve equity curves, (2) computes 60d rolling return + DD per sleeve, (3) rotates active sleeve every 7d. This is documented as the gap for future rounds.
limitations.execution_complexity: HIGH - requires portfolio-level state machine beyond current per-strategy runtime
